#Mead - DRinks1	T1 Event
country_event = {
	id = we.016
	title = we_drinks_mead.t #Mead
	desc = we_drinks_mead.d # 
	picture = GFX_we_event_016
	mean_time_to_happen = { months = 120 }
	trigger = {
			1 = {
				trade_share = {
					country = ROOT
					share = 10
					}
				NOT = { owned_by = ROOT }
				owner = {
					has_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						value = 150 
						}
					}
				}
			
			NOT = { has_country_flag = we_drinks_mead_unlock }		
			}
			
	immediate = {	
			set_country_flag = we_drinks_mead_unlock
			play_sound = we_drinks_mead_sound
				}

	option = {
				name = "we_drinks_mead.a" 
				add_prestige = 25
				add_adm_power = 10
				add_country_modifier = {				
									name = we_drinks_mead_mod			
									duration = 3650
									}
			}
}

country_event = {
	id = we.028
	title = we_drinks_port_wine.t #port_wine
	desc = we_drinks_port_wine.d # 
	picture = GFX_we_event_028
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {}
	option = {
			name = "we_drinks_test_variables" 
			
			acw_remove_all_modifiers_lack_of = yes

					variable_name = naval_forcelimit_unlimiter

                        }
                    }

                value = 0.25
                }
            }

                    amount = 0.50
